caption: A string of fairy lights is unplugged from the wall, and the whole string goes dark.

sa.check: A string of fairy lights, lit, with its plug in a wall socket.
Every bulb goes dark, none stays lit.
The order is lit, pull, dark.

pc.expect: All the bulbs go dark at the moment the plug leaves the socket, and only then, together.
pc.fail: The plug is out and bulbs still glow; or the string goes dark before the plug moves; or the bulbs go out one after another along the string; or the string goes dark with the plug still seated.

pc.expect: The dark bulbs are the same bulbs seen lit: the same number at the same spots along the wire.
pc.fail: Bulbs vanish rather than going dark; or new bulbs appear along the wire; or bulbs shift along the wire; or the wire shortens or lengthens.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the string stays dark while the plug is out.
pc.fail: Bulbs come back on with the plug out; or the string flickers; or the plug jumps back into the socket by itself; or the bulbs glow faintly on.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops once the plug is free; the string stays where it hangs.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or the string falls from its hooks as the plug is pulled.

pc.expect: One string, one plug, one socket; the plug leaves the socket whole; nothing passes through the wall.
pc.fail: The plug passes through the wall beside the socket; or the wire splits or detaches; or a second plug appears; or the socket comes off the wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The wire's colour, the socket and the background stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The wire changes colour; or the socket changes design; or the background rearranges.
